name: In for a Penny
source: This is a harem-themed visual novel game. The story will revolve around our main character who finds himself in a difficult situation. You will follow him as he tries to complete his mission, given by the Overseers to bed a town full of women and uncover the mysteries of his situation.
translation: 这是一部后宫题材视觉小说。故事围绕身陷棘手处境的男主角展开：你将跟随他的脚步，看他如何设法完成“监察者”下达的使命——睡遍全镇的女人，并揭开自身处境背后的重重谜团。
